lighting_shading.note: Soft, even lighting with no cast shadow, typical of mobile game assets.

value_contrast.note: High separation due to complementary colors and strong value difference.

color_palette.note: Vibrant orange subject against a bright blue background creates maximum pop.

composition_hierarchy.note: Perfectly centered and isolated, making the object the sole focus.
